messages:
Maria: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's GPU surge. I'm consolidating action items so we can close the loop. Short list below — please claim ownership and drop ETA.

Maria: Main vectors: quota exhaustion on tenant pools, scheduler backpressure config that delayed preemption, and insufficient headroom thresholds during nightly batch spikes. Recurring pattern: end-of-quarter eval jobs + small-scale deployments.

Maria: Proposed action items (initial owners):
1) Quota review + temporary bump for critical tenants -> AJ
2) Scheduler tuning: `preemptionGrace` and `evictionWindow` -> Liam
3) Headroom cadence: daily safety buffer + surge window rules -> Sara
4) Automated surge signal runbook + alert-to-playbook binding -> Eva
5) Postmortem cleanup: ensure runbook links & test prompts -> Maria

Maria: Minimal ask: confirm owner, give ETA (date), and add one-sentence plan. If you want to reassign, say so. We'll fold into the remediation tracker.

AJ: I can take quota review. Will pull current usage sheet and talk to finance about a short-term bump. ETA: 2026-04-02. Plan: create PR to adjust tenant caps + docs for manual override. @Maria acked. :+1:

Liam: On scheduler knobs. I'll run a config sweep in staging tomorrow and post results. ETA: 2026-03-30. Plan: tune `evictionWindow=15s`, `preemptionGrace=3s`, and measure tail latency.

Sara: Headroom cadence — I propose a rolling safety buffer that increases during 22:00-04:00 UTC batch window. I'll draft the cadence and add checks to the monitor. ETA: 2026-03-31.

Eva: I'll own the surge signal runbook automation. Adding an automated responder that escalates to oncall and triggers temporary routing to dedicated pools. ETA: 2026-04-05. Will stub the runbook:```yaml
- trigger: gpu_utilization > 85% for 3m
  actions:
    - notify: #oncall-escalation
    - route: dedicated-fallback
```

Maria: Nice. Let's also ensure rollback timers are explicit. If we route to dedicated-fallback, it should auto-unroute after 30m unless confirmed.

AJ: understood. I'll include a manual rollback button in the ops console PR.

ops-bot: Reminder: Please add due dates in the remediation tracker. Missing: Sara, Eva.

Sara: Adding due date now (2026-03-31). Done.

Eva: Added due date 2026-04-05 and linked runbook draft in the tracker.

Liam: Quick question — do we want the scheduler sweep gated behind a canary? I can run canary on 10% of pods first.

Maria: Yes, canary is required. Add a metric gate for 95th tail latency and error rate. If degradation > 5% abort.

Liam: Will do. Scheduling canary for 2026-03-29 10:00 UTC.

Maria: Thanks all. I'll update the master remediation doc and set weekly check-ins until all items are closed. If anyone hits blockers, ping #eng-sre and drop a short standup note. :heart:

AJ: Acked.

Sara: Ack.

Eva: Ack.

Liam: Ack.
